# SUTF8.txt - SUCS UTF-8 framing (starter)
# SUCS_CP is uint32_t, 31 bits significant (0..0x7FFFFFFF).
# Framing follows the standard UTF-8 leading-byte design:
#   1 byte : 0xxxxxxx            -> 7 bits
#   2 bytes: 110xxxxx 10xxxxxx   -> 11 bits
#   3 bytes: 1110xxxx 10xxxxxx.. -> 16 bits
#   4 bytes: 11110xxx 10xxxxxx.. -> 21 bits
# Base SUCS never emits a 4-byte sequence above 0x7FFFFFFF (high bit
# cleared in the last byte). See sutf/sutf.h for the reference tables.
